items.text: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.334

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the highway law, in relation to designating portions of the
state highway system as "The Disabled American Veterans - Medal of Honor
Memorial Highway", "The Medal of Honor Memorial Highway"and the "Sergeant
Jonathan Gollnitz - Medal of Honor Memorial Highway"

summary: Designates portions of the state highway system as "The Disabled American Veterans - New York Medal of Honor Highway" and the "New York Medal of Honor Highway"; renames the "Sergeant Jonathan Gollnitz Memorial Highway" as the "Sergeant Jonathan Gollnitz - New York Medal of Honor Highway".
title: Designates portions of the state highway system as "The Disabled American Veterans - New York Medal of Honor Highway" and the "New York Medal of Honor Highway"
